chunks: Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, writes for him, for every hair over which his hand passes, one good deed.

key_terms.حَسَنَةً: a good deed or meritorious act recorded as reward
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is reported; an account transmitted without a stated sanad/isnad here
key_terms.يَكْتُبُ: He records or writes down as reward

ai.seo_question: What reward is mentioned for gently passing one’s hand over an orphan’s head?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great reward for showing kindness to an orphan, even in a gentle and simple act. Allah عزّ وجلّ grants a good deed for every hair touched, highlighting the immense spiritual merit of mercy toward orphans.
